_doc: Playable races (sys-races). Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-fighter-lifecycle.md. All age curves derive from lifespan via humanAge = age * 80 / lifespan (O11). statTendencies are offsets in stat points (1-20 scale) applied to per-stat caps at generation. The 'derived' blocks are EXAMPLE reference values from the spec's worked examples and soak model; code must compute from the formulas and never read them. Fractions are decimals here; the loader converts them to integer basis points.
status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (fighter-lifecycle designer). Lifespan scaling, human peak 28, elf ~42, and 'long-lived = more injury-prone, orcs/dwarves shorter-lived and more durable' are REQUIRED (O11); the values chosen for them and everything else are PROPOSED / TUNABLE. M1.1 PROPOSAL (2026-10-26): adds the stamina stat id and per-race stamina tendencies (orc and dwarf higher, elf and Ashkin lower; within the +/-4 cap).

stats._doc: statTendencies are keyed by the combat.json attribute ids (final): physical str (Strength), agi (Agility), pac (Pace), tgh (Toughness, the durability input to sys-injury), pre (Precision), stamina (Stamina, M1.1: drives Freshness); mental arc (Arcana), spi (Spirit), wil (Willpower), cmp (Composure), ldr (Leadership), awr (Awareness), dis (Discipline). The physical/mental group comes from combat.json. Tendencies are cap offsets in stat points at generation.
stats._capNote: TUNABLE (combat cmb-q11): |statTendency| <= 4 per stat; races express fragility and durability mainly through injury multipliers, not raw stat gaps. Current values stay within +/-1.6.

classArchetypes._doc: Soft class affinities are keyed by combat.json affinityGroups (each class in classes.json has one affinityGroup). Generation weight of a class = 1 * race.classAffinity[class.affinityGroup]. Affinity never changes in-fight power.

races.name: Human
races.flavor: The restless middle folk: found in every arena, good at whatever they are made to practise.

racialFeature.name: Adaptable
racialFeature.text: Training emphasis effects are 1.5x as strong.

races.name: Elf
races.flavor: Long-lived and light of bone. They ripen slowly, hold their prime for an age, and break more easily than anyone.

racialFeature.name: Long Prime
racialFeature.text: Every phase of an elf's career lasts 1.5x as many seasons as a human's: the slow climb, the long prime and the long decline.
racialFeature._note: Descriptive: the behaviour comes from lifespan alone.

derived.mentalDeclineFromAge: 90 if mental decline scales with lifespan (recommended), else 60

races.name: Dwarf
races.flavor: Dwarves count their lives in hard decades: fewer years than humans, every one of them weathered. Hard to injure, slow on their feet.

racialFeature.name: Bedrock
racialFeature.text: Physical decline is 15% slower than lifespan alone would give.

derived.mentalDeclineFromAge: 54 if mental decline scales with lifespan (recommended), else 60

races.name: Orc
races.flavor: Quick to grow, quick to heal, quick to grey. Built thick, hit hard, and are done by thirty.

derived.mentalDeclineFromAge: 48 if mental decline scales with lifespan (recommended), else 60

races.name: Ashkin
races.flavor: Ember-blooded folk who reach their full heat within a few seasons of arriving and gutter out before thirty. (Original race; working name.)

racialFeature.name: Ready-Made
racialFeature.text: Arrive close to their prime: an Ashkin debuting at 16 is the equivalent of a human aged about 25.
racialFeature._note: Descriptive: follows from lifespan and the debut-age floor of 16.

derived.mentalDeclineFromAge: 39 if mental decline scales with lifespan (recommended), else 60
